name: button
title: Button
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A pill button in four tones and three sizes. Use when the user takes an action; solid is the one primary action per view.

hairline.purpose: The one pressable shape in the system.
dontUseWhen: selecting from a set of options

insteadUse.navigating between pages: a link styled with buttonVariants via asChild

hairline.antiExampleWhy: Stock Tailwind palette colours are not Hairline tokens, the radius is not the pill the system uses, and "Submit" is not a plain verb naming what will happen.

docs: Exactly one `tone="solid"` button per view. Use `quiet` for the action beside it, `ghost` for tertiary, and `danger` only for destructive actions.
